nodes.original_target: Flatness d1 o d0 = 0 of the cochain window is assumed in the l1 framework.
A finite primal-dual certificate (potential h, annihilating dual witness) certifies l1 optimality of the quotient residual. Lean covers integer-list instances; the real-vector statement is prose.

Under H1-H5 the aggregate seminorm is an edgewise weighted l1 sum (Thm 1), with orbit-constant weights under graph symmetry (Thm 2); with edge-transitivity the weights collapse to unweighted l1 (Thm 3). Counterexamples CE1-CE5 show each axiom is used.

A faithful, edge-additive, maximal bounded-linear symmetry on the gauge presentation gives weighted l1 as the outer aggregation. Alternative route to l1 to L1-GS000-EDGEWISE-L1, with a different hypothesis set.

Declared observer axioms on a finite edge-indexed projection: H1 edge locality, H2 coordinate permutation symmetry, H3 disjoint-coordinate additivity, H4 graph-isomorphism invariance with an l1-isometric fiber action, H5 seminorm homogeneity. They are inputs to the l1 classification results, not consequences of Genesis.

For a finite-dimensional repair packet with c = d0, Phi1([x]) equals the Banach-quotient norm of the cofiber shadow. The Lean statement named in the ledger is definitional, so the analytic identity is carried by the prose proof only. The unrestricted CODA-A bridge is refused / OPEN.
l1 appears when aggregation over independent replicas is required to be extensive. WDP 8.5 states that l2 is not excluded by this argument.

A finite cochain window (C0,C1,C2,d0,d1) with d1 d0 = 0 has quotient Q1 = C1/im(d0). Phi1([x]) is the quotient seminorm (min over potentials of the weighted l1 norm of x - d0 h). Gamma2 is the l1 norm of d1 applied to a minimizer, and R_cl = Gamma2/Phi1. Missing or ill-typed window data gives a typed NoRule refusal. Gamma2 here is a norm; QM_020 uses 'Gamma' for a set of residual sectors.

A declared mass m: W -> R>=0 on witnesses gives finite additivity by construction. With positive total mass the normalized cell values are nonnegative and sum to one (P01); atom-mass uniqueness holds on finite Boolean algebras (O01). WDP 8.1: plurality or number is not derived from one cut. WDP-CH09-N01: a finite witness valuation is not chance, frequency, or the Born rule.

The circle group U(1) as phase group. The leftover (1,1) vs (1,-1) is already seen over {+1,-1}, so it does not select the circle. Under the extra 'not of exponent two' the sign group is excluded; Gaussian units and a three-cycle meet the extra. The circle itself and continuity of a one-parameter phase group stay hypotheses.

Complex numbers as a complete field. On the finite report host only Z[i] (Gaussian integers) is available: 1+i has no inverse, and a self-adjoint Gauss-integer matrix need not have a Gauss-integer eigenvalue.

Continuous time, topology, a one-parameter unitary group and Stone's theorem. The two-state toggle has no report-level square root; after complex coefficients, interpolants exist at scale 4 and are not unique.
Transition from the finite presented carrier (integer weights, finite report labels) to a continuous infinite-dimensional Hilbert space. QM_122 section 6 refuses it; QM_020 demotion box fences it.

The class of completely positive trace-preserving maps. Collapse non-reversibility and failure of a same-basis isometry are not CPTP obstructions; exactly four reversible dilations of collapse exist under the declared convention that the ancilla starts at false.

Uniqueness of the Born quadratic form at dimension n >= 3 needs Gleason-type hypotheses (noncontextuality, sigma-additivity, continuity). On the two-label host the dimension extra already fails; the weaker unit-effect contract has two disagreeing pairings (4 versus 1 on the false-indicator at amplitudes (2,1)).

Hilbert tensor product as the unique way to combine systems. On Bool x Bool a bilinear integer-homogeneous Kronecker-normalized map equals the pointwise product; a weaker same-host combining interface has a rival (dump-the-right-report map).

For an l1 residual v with mass M(v) > 0, psi(v)_i = sgn(v_i) sqrt(|v_i| / M(v)) gives the rank-one real projector rho(v) = psi psi^T, a real L2 lift. The alignment statistic Xi = (1/2) ||rho(h*) - rho(phi*)||_tr is strictly below 1 by complementary slackness. Xi depends on coordinate order and is undefined at zero residual. It does not derive QM.
Complex scalars as a field are declared, not derived. The finite stand-in is Q(i) / Z[i]; Z[i] is not a field (H007 gi_not_embedded).
Phase averaging uses independent uniform (Haar) phases on each sector. The Rust implementation substitutes a declared finite phase group.
A Hilbert inner product on the linearized carrier is admitted, not derived. H005 exhibits more than one admissible Gram form on the same carrier.
